backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing invoice and payment management with role-based access control, including functions for uploading invoices, processing single and batch payments, managing user profiles, and generating reports with proper authorization checks.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: replacing 'DSE name' with 'Salesman Name' in reports export and adding a 'Retailer Name' column to final report exports.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend TypeScript/React files covering authentication, payment entry (single and batch), invoice management, reports, and UI components with role-based access control.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Production deployment checklist covering authentication, admin/user features, UI/UX verification, data integrity checks, browser compatibility, and known limitations including first-user-becomes-admin behavior.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components including sidebar, charts, and semantic tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the ADPL Payment Entry & Collection Tracking System React application with viewport meta tags and root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component using TanStack Router to define routes for login, admin dashboard, user management, payment entry (single and batch), payment history, edit payment, and reports with authentication guards and role-based access control.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Access denied screen component displaying a shield alert icon and message explaining that admin permissions are required and must be granted by an administrator.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to set up their profile with a name field; saves profile with default 'user' role and invalidates user queries on success.
Alert banner prompting authenticated users without profiles to complete setup; dismissible and opens ProfileSetupModal when clicked.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main application layout with header, navigation (admin/user-specific), mobile menu, and logout; displays ProfileSetupPrompt for users without profiles.
frontend/src/components/payments/BatchPa: Form component for batch payment entry displaying selected invoices grouped by retailer, payment mode selection, amount input with validation, and conditional fields for cheque/online payment details.
frontend/src/components/payments/Invoice: Searchable invoice selection component with checkboxes; filters invoices by number/retailer and displays selected invoices grouped by retailer with running total.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Dynamic form editor for multiple payment lines supporting cash, cheque, and online transfer modes; allows adding/removing payment lines with mode-specific fields.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: A filter component for reports that allows filtering by date range, salesman name, payment type, and payment mode. Converts HTML date inputs to bigint timestamps and provides dropdown selections for salesmen and payment options.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payment entries grouped by retailer code in a table format, showing payment details including date, invoices, type, mode, transaction info, and amounts. Calculates and displays total amounts per retailer.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: A paginated table component displaying invoices with sortable ageing days column, status badges, and navigation buttons to view invoice details, payment history, or batch payment entry. Shows 10 invoices per page with currency formatting.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Hook that fetches the current user's profile and role from the backend actor. Returns user profile data, effective role from backend, loading states, and admin status flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for managing user login/logout with AuthClient. Creates a React context provider that handles identity state, login status, and authentication lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including invoices, payments, payment history, and user profiles. Handles query invalidation on mutations to keep data synchronized.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for UI components like backgrounds, borders, buttons, and charts.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard displaying key financial metrics (total outstanding, collection, excess, pending balance) as cards with icons, and navigation cards to upload data, view invoices, and access other features.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Invoice management page for admins to upload Excel files with invoice data, download templates, clear all data, and view/search invoices with filters for retailer name, code, invoice number, and salesman.
frontend/src/pages/admin/UserManagementP: User management page for admins to view all registered users, display their roles (admin or regular user) with icons, and change user roles through a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that handles Internet Identity authentication with error handling, retry logic for existing sessions, and displays welcome UI with instructions for first-time users and admin access.
frontend/src/pages/payments/BatchPayment: Batch payment entry page allowing users to select multiple invoices, enter payment details (amount, mode, transaction/cheque info, date), validate inputs, and submit batch payments for one or more retailers.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Page component for editing an existing payment entry with form fields for amount, payment mode (cash/cheque/bank transfer), and mode-specific details like transaction ID, cheque number, and dates with validation.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Page component for creating new payment entries against an invoice, supporting multiple payment lines with different modes (cash/cheque/online), calculating totals, and handling excess payments.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a table of all payment history for a specific retailer, showing payment dates, invoice numbers, types, modes, amounts, and references with admin-only edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Reports dashboard with filters for date range, salesman, payment type/mode, displaying summary statistics (total collected, excess, pending balance) and a retailer-wise ledger with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: TypeScript interface defining the PaymentLine type with fields for payment mode (cash/cheque/online) and mode-specific details like amounts, bank info, cheque details, and transaction IDs.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Utility function to parse CSV/XLSX invoice files, validating required columns (Retailer Code, Name, Invoice Number, Date, Salesman, Balance Amount) and converting rows into Invoice objects.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Exports payment reports to CSV format with summary statistics and detailed payment entries, including columns for payment dates, retailer info, invoice numbers, salesman names, payment modes, and mode-specific details (cheque/bank transfer).
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Generates and downloads a CSV template file for invoice uploads with headers including Retailer Code, Retailer Name, Invoice Number, Invoice Date, Ageing Days, Salesman Name, and Balance Amount.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides invoice filtering functionality based on retailer name, retailer code, invoice number, and salesman name with case-insensitive matching.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Calculates and formats invoice ageing days by parsing various date formats and computing the difference between invoice date and current date.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes invoice status from various formats (string enum, variant object) into canonical string keys: 'unpaid', 'partiallyPaid', 'paid', or 'excess'.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentDates: Provides utilities for deriving effective payment dates based on payment mode (bank transfer date, cheque date, or created timestamp) and converting between HTML date inputs and backend nanosecond timestamps.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates payment totals from multiple payment lines and determines payment status (Fully Paid, Partially Paid, or Excess Payment) by comparing total paid against balance amount.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from query strings or hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and parameter cleanup capabilities.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry forms by checking payment type, ensuring at least one valid payment line exists, and validating mode-specific required fields (cheque number/date, transaction ID/date).
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH, extended theme settings for containers, borders, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document indicating two completed features: replacing 'DSE name' with 'Salesman Name' and adding 'Retailer Name' column to report exports.
